title: The open count in the Reassign dialog counts exactly four statuses
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in to the build under test as a dispatcher whose role has Work Orders view and Work Orders create and edit (check: Settings > Roles & Permissions > open the role > on the Work Orders card, View and Create & Edit are both ticked. The Admin role has both).
  2. In the top bar, choose the location you test in (e.g. "Heavy Duty"). Every technician and work order below belongs to this location.
  3. Use a desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (the display switcher only shows at 1024 px and wider).
  4. The location has these eligible technicians (examples): "ZZAUTOTEST Ana Alpha", "ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo".
    • A staff member counts as a technician when, in Settings > Staff > open the staff member > Edit Staff Member, they are Active, the Time Clock (clockable) setting is on, the role is neither Office nor Time Clock User, and they are enrolled at this location.
    • To add one: Settings > Staff > add a staff member with those settings (e.g. first name "ZZAUTOTEST Ana", last name "Alpha").
  5. How to create each work order below:
    • Work Orders > New Work Order > pick the customer (add it from the window if it does not exist, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Alpha Co") and any asset > Create.
    • On the work order page set Lead Technician to the technician named (leave it empty for an unassigned one).
    • Move it to the status named: a new work order starts as Estimate; approve the estimate for Approved; use the status control on the work order page for In Progress, Review (Ready for Review) and Complete; decline the estimate for Declined; Finance tab > Create Invoice for Invoiced; record a payment for the full amount for Paid. Set the lead technician before invoicing.
    • Write down each work order number as you create it (e.g. S1-801).
  6. Seed these work orders at this location (customers "ZZAUTOTEST …"), lead Ben unless stated:
    • Counted: Approved (1), In Progress (1), Review / Ready for Review (1), Complete (1) = 4.
    • Not counted: Estimate (1), Invoiced (1), Paid (1), Declined (1).
    • Not counted: an Approved work order with lead Ana where Ben is only the technician on one line.
  7. A second location where Ben is also enrolled (Settings > Locations, then enrol Ben there), with one Approved work order led by Ben at that location. Not counted here.
  8. One spare Approved work order with lead Ana, e.g. "ZZAUTOTEST Spare Co", to open the dialog from.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders from the top menu and click the All tab.
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST" in Search so only your test work orders show.
  3. Click Board View in the display switcher (the design tooltip reads "Board").
  4. Hover the Spare Co card, click more-actions (…) > "Reassign lead technician".
  5. Find Ben Bravo in the list and read his open count, then cancel the dialog.
  6. Click Status and tick "Estimate" only, open the dialog from any visible card, read Ben's count, then cancel and clear the filter.
  7. Open Ben's Estimate work order, approve it, come back and open the dialog again. Read Ben's count.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: Ben shows 4 open (Approved 1 + In Progress 1 + Ready for Review 1 + Complete 1 = 4). Estimate, Invoiced, Paid and Declined, the line-only work order, and the work order at the other location are not counted.
  • Step 6: still 4 open. The page filter does not change the count.
  • Step 7: 5 open (4 + 1) right after the Estimate became Approved.
  • The design shows a count of all of a technician's work orders (e.g. "4 open" including Paid and Invoiced). If the build counts that way, it is a fail against the four statuses.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S4-R15, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, DR-43 (29 Sep 2026). Lead only, current location and ignoring page filters: Sasha Grosman's answer to MF-3 in the PRD footer comment of 24 Sep 2026, recorded in the tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) section 1.4.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R15: “The dialog’s N open count includes Approved, In Progress, Ready for Review, and Complete work orders.”
  • Tech plan 1.4 MF-3: “Confirmed plus Complete: lead only, current location, Approved / In Progress / Ready for Review / Complete, ignoring page filters (PRD S4-R15 not yet updated)”
